title: Greatsword +1

fields.Weapon profile: 2d6 + 1 Slashing, 5 ft melee. Martial, two-handed, heavy and dippable.
fields.Cleave: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Attack up to 3 non-allied creatures or objects in a 7 ft cone, dealing half normal weapon damage. Flat bonuses such as Rage are not halved.
fields.Lacerate: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Make a melee weapon attack. DC is weapon-action DC +2, Constitution save or Bleeding for 2 turns. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Pommel Strike: Bonus Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Make a nonlethal melee attack for 1d4 Bludgeoning. DC is weapon-action DC +2, Constitution save or Dazed for 2 turns. Does not apply main-hand weapon riders.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by traders using the magic melee weapon table.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
